item.title: Rallying Cry – November 14, 2026
item.description: A Mexican teen invented a solar water heater, Pakistan scored a dramatic late winner to reach the SAFF Championship final, Chennai is using drones to monitor flood-prone areas, and a Brisbane daycare center got a lifeline thanks to community support.
